title: Directive bundle-size budgets
description: Budgets enforced by scripts/size-check.ts. Each entry names a built entry file; the enforced number is that file plus every emitted file it imports, gzipped together.

_README.description: Why these numbers are what they are, for whoever has to raise one.

path.description: Path to a built entry file, relative to the repo root. Name the entry, never a chunk-*.js — chunk names are content-hashed and change on the next build that touches anything.

gzBudget.description: Ceiling in bytes for the gzipped closure, at zlib's default level.
